children: Overview
U.S. regional bank's Q3 core EPS rose yr/yr
Net interest income declined slightly from prior quarter but rose 16.6% yr/yr
Company announced 22% increase in quarterly dividend and merger with Lincoln Bancorp
Outlook
Company expects Q4 net interest margin of 4.25-4.35%, excluding Lincoln impact
Equity Bancshares forecasts Q4 non-interest income of $10 mln to $11 mln, excluding Lincoln
Company sees Q4 non-interest expense between $47 mln and $48 mln, excluding Lincoln impact
Result Drivers
ORGANIC LOAN GROWTH - Co said organic loan growth, particularly in legacy markets, contributed to results
HIGHER INTEREST EXPENSE - Co said increased deposit costs outpaced growth in interest income, leading to lower net interest income quarter over quarter
NON-INTEREST INCOME GROWTH - Co said growth in service charges, treasury services, card income and trust/wealth management revenue drove non-interest income higher
